summary: Implementation plan for unifying the navigation menu buttons across all non-lobby routes (/town/, /orders/, /characters/, /warehouse/, /workshop/, /apartment/) using a standardized GothicDock floating navigation bar with uniform sizing, spacing, active highlights, and canonical Gothic glyphs (♜ 公寓, ♟ 角色, ❦ 委托, ⚜ 探索, ♧ 仓库).
